Daily Devotional

September 28

23 Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God. (Psalms 50:23 KJV)

When you praise God you glorify Him. To glorify means to give glory, high praise, exalt or honor Him. Elsewhere the same Greek word that was translated “glorifieth”, is translated magnify and honor in other scriptures, so you can see that praise magnifies and honors the Father, so praise is a wonderful way to bring all these blessings to God, as He is blessed by our praise. It is amazing to think that God is blessed by our praise! We should always enter into His presence with praise and thanksgiving, as it will bless Him (Psalms 100:4).

Elsewhere in Scripture it tells us that praise also drives the devil away, as he can not stand to hear God being praised. When you realize that praising the Lord will not only bless Him, but drive the devil crazy, you should want to praise the Lord at all times. If you are a Christian, then praise should be something you want to do anyway, as it also makes your faith abound, and will do all those things mentioned as well as being a faith builder. I can not think of any one thing more important then our praise and thankfulness to the Lord, as it does so much for us, and blesses the Lord at the same time, as well as running the devil off. I think I will praise the Lord at all times as the Word tells us to. Who deserves our praise and thanks more than our Heavenly Father does? Be thankful and praise Him today, and always.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
